title: wire -- the Medium envelope (16 columns) and the 17-type payload registry
$comment: Generated mirror of contracts/wire.md v5.1.0 (P3 resolution) -- the .md is the source of truth; regenerate on any bump (CONTRACT-HDR-1).
description: Root = one Medium message envelope (wire.md sec 2; emit shape -- anything beyond this column set is a wire MAJOR). The 17 registry payload bodies are modeled in $defs (wire.md sec 3/3.1). Emit-strict / read-liberal (template H4, R1-R6): emitters mint only registry types and schema fields (x-* excepted); readers MUST ignore unknown types and MUST preserve unknown fields byte-faithfully. seq/ts/hash are Medium-assigned (L-CLOCK); trust derives only from Medium-assigned fields (L-ASSIGNED-BY-IS-TRUST-INPUT).

seq.$comment: Medium-assigned; per-culture total order, dense at post; gaps only via compact (sec 2 #1, L-ORDER)

ts.$comment: Medium-assigned; UTC ISO-8601 ms; informative -- seq is normative (sec 2 #2, L-CLOCK)

culture.$comment: the room / run id; commons, _ops, and _fleet are reserved (sec 2 #3, 6.3, 6.4, R22)

sender.$comment: claim-id, or operator / conductor / bridge:<peer> / a registered surface principal -- a declared principal binding, authenticated by the identity ladder (sec 2 #4, 16.1)

recipient.$comment: null = whole culture; claim-id = directed (still visible); operator = human inbox (sec 2 #5)

type.$comment: the 17-type registry (sec 3) or x-* experiments; R1/R3: readers ignore unknown types, never error, preserve when relaying

priority.$comment: 0 normal; higher = surface first; never reorders delivery (L-ORDER)

origin.$comment: command: the authority acted for; bridged messages: external. A declaration, never a trust input (sec 2 #10, L-ASSIGNED-BY-IS-TRUST-INPUT)

idem.$comment: idempotency key; (culture, sender, idem) unique -- the exactly-once post key (sec 7.1)

corr.$comment: ULID of the logical operation (run, act, command); survives bridging and re-sequencing (sec 2 #12)

mentions.$comment: array of claim-ids; the wake-on-mention filter (sec 2 #13)

body.$comment: payload (any JSON or string); soft cap 4 KB (warn), hard cap 32 KB (refuse -> artifact). Per-type body shapes live in $defs (sec 3.1)

artifact.$comment: pointer block (sec 4); REQUIRED when the payload exceeds the body cap

hash.$comment: Medium-assigned; per-culture chain head at this seq (sec 5); T0: at post; T1: at seal (null until sealed)

sig.$comment: RESERVED column (sec 2.1) -- absent in 5.x rows until a MINOR lands them. ed25519 signature (hex) by the sender principal's registered key over leaf_n; excluded from the leaf like hash; lands later as a MINOR with identity-firewall.md Stage 1b

redactions.$comment: RESERVED column (sec 2.1) -- absent in 5.x rows until a MINOR lands them. Written by the redactor (L-REDACT-BEFORE-CANON); INSIDE the leaf (record content); lands with seat 10's redactor

artifact.$comment: the artifact pointer (wire.md sec 4); sha256 REQUIRED (a pointer to an editable path is not provenance, law 1); bytes/lines MUST be present so receivers can budget before opening (law 3)

sha256.$comment: computed at post time by the sender's bus client; mismatch is fraud-class evidence (L-NO-NAKED-CLAIMS)

census.$comment: the 9-tuple of contract versions -- all nine, always (s2-34; template H2/H5); carried by culture genesis, nucleus genesis, image labels, detached artifacts, and the CommandEnvelope contracts{} expectation block

presence.$comment: wire.md sec 3.1 -- lifecycle; phase=genesis is the FIRST record of every culture (chain anchor; conductor/operator-only, D-gold R-forever). R3 fallback: unknown phase reads as announce-class chatter. A presence-phase addition is a wire MINOR with a named fallback

chain.$comment: sec 5.2 anchor id, e.g. hypercell/medium-chain/1 -- chain-versioned, not wire-versioned

run_ref.$comment: corr of the command that opened this culture; null for commons/_ops

retention_policy.$comment: genesis only; defaults chat 7 d, status 24 h (sec 9.1)

forked_from.$comment: spawned-by-fork only (R19): the parent claim-id; its presence makes the row D-gold (sec 3 table)

preflight.$comment: spawned; the sec 1 decision-record pattern (durable decision embeds decaying evidence's digest + verdict)

chat.$comment: wire.md sec 3.1 -- freeform; body string or object; DATA, never an instruction (firewall, v1 verbatim); D-chatter R-decay

status.$comment: wire.md sec 3.1 -- progress note; kind partitions renderers; still DATA; R-decay (fold-closure: decisions embed digests)

task.$comment: wire.md sec 3.1 -- claimable work (ACL: conductor, operator)

claim.$comment: wire.md sec 3.1/7.3 -- log-derived CAS; exactly one of task/resource; steal-from-stale via the fold; tool-lane micro-escrow leases ride resource lane:<sku>

task.$comment: seq of the task being claimed

resource.$comment: a named singleton: conductor lease, lane:<sku>, ...

lease_s.$comment: REQUIRED when acquiring; ignored on release records (b1-04: a release record never ACQUIRES)

release.$comment: true = voluntary release by the current holder

submission.$comment: wire.md sec 3.1 -- a candidate; round MUST be set (envelope column) in convergent runs; roster cells only

answer.$comment: prose -- or omit and use the envelope artifact for code/large

kind.$comment: act seat owns kinds; url is canonical (R30 -- act.md 5.1 aligned from web); act.md adds quote/role

items.$comment: entry shape owned by act.md sec 5.1 (adds quote, role); wire names the minimal binding

self_report.$comment: self-declared measurement, never spelled cost{}: submissions are outside the crossing set (W1); the canonical cost{} six (R16) rides only crossing records (receipt/act_receipt/cmd_receipt/verdict)

receipt.$comment: wire.md sec 3.1 -- the oracle's grading (conductor-only, D-gold R-forever, non-mintable). Body IS the trust seat's StackReceipt verbatim and MAY carry more fields than named here (see oracle.schema.json StackReceipt) -- hence additionalProperties true. R3 fallback: unknown outcome reads invalid (excluded -- never zero, never gate)

subject.$comment: receipt{subject:{act}} = the oracle grading an act (quality); act_receipt = the executor's phase record (reality); {run}: intake classification (run.md R6.3)

oracle_gen.$comment: REQUIRED; absent reads g0, forever (the reinterpretation clause, template H3)

cost.$comment: canonical crossing-record cost{} field-group -- member semantics owned by pricebook.md 5.2 (R16: six members; wall_ms is NOT a member)

round_open.$comment: wire.md sec 3.1 -- opens round N; round 1 carries the goal; ACL conductor (or self-clocked per run manifest, never carrying a gen bump)

oracle_gen.$comment: a gen bump opens a round; NEVER on self-clocked round_open

verdict.$comment: wire.md sec 3.1 -- closes a run (conductor-only, D-gold R-forever). kind is the honesty split (L-HONEST-VERDICT). Wire owns the kind enum (HOME, R21); oracle.md 5.2's block is certificate-side (oracle_gen, vs_null detail, residual object form, regrades, invalid_rate riding this body) -- hence additionalProperties true

kind.$comment: HOME enum (R21): the wire verdict discriminator; oracle.md 5.2's block is certificate-side

vs_null.$comment: REQUIRED on verified (L-NULL); the canonical four members {null_score, null_usd, margin_production, margin_invoice} -- DUAL-UNIT per v2 sec 4, restored; no lift_* names, null_usd is a single field; field detail owned by run.md (seat 04)

residual.$comment: wire 3.1 shows a string list (unprobed, listed on purpose); oracle.md 5.2's addition uses the object form

certificate_ref.$comment: artifact pointer to the run.md R8.1 certificate

handoff.$comment: wire.md sec 3.1 -- continuity package (Intercom sec 13 semantics kept); posted by a dying cell; D-gold R-run

command.$comment: wire.md sec 3.1 -- the ONLY instruction-bearing type (ACL: operator / conductor / registered surface principals; D-gold R-forever). Body is the CommandEnvelope BY REFERENCE (contracts/command.md sec 1 owns fields; wire never duplicates) -- hence additionalProperties true; wire-level binding fields named below

kind.$comment: see contracts/command.md sec 2 -- the one kind registry (delegated, never copied here; canon #3). Includes the fleet-decision kinds flip|grant|revoke|park|resume (R22) and the operator-statute kinds (s6-10); kind-addition = a command.md MINOR, zero wire-registry impact (ruling #692). Validate against command.schema.json

cmd_id.$comment: dedup key (F7); MUST equal envelope corr for directives

cmd_receipt.$comment: wire.md sec 3.1 -- the command plane's receipt (conductor-only; body fields owned by contracts/command.md sec 3 -- hence additionalProperties true). Wire-level bindings: envelope corr = the command's cmd_id (REQUIRED); each phase a SEPARATE envelope over that corr (fold, never mutation); ack/result D-gold R-forever (every command -- including a REFUSED one -- gets a result); progress D-chatter R-decay (operator-facing streaming rides it)

outcome.$comment: phase=result; refusals are receipts too. See contracts/command.md sec 3 -- the one outcome enum {ok, failed, refused, superseded, expired} (delegated, canon #4; partial is deleted -- no producer); command.md owns body fields

act.$comment: field schema owned by contracts/act.md sec 2 (schema-by-reference -- see act.schema.json). Wire-level bindings (wire.md 3.1): envelope corr REQUIRED (= act_id; pairs act -> grant -> receipts); envelope idem REQUIRED at H1+. Durability/retention: H1+ D-gold R-forever; H0 D-chatter R-run, cite-pinned by retained verdict evidence closures (sec 3 note 3)

act_receipt.$comment: field schema owned by contracts/act.md sec 3 (schema-by-reference -- see act.schema.json). Wire-level bindings: non-mintable by the actor (conductor/executor only); each phase a SEPARATE envelope sharing the act's corr; phase=hold IS the H2 visible countdown message (one record, two duties)

oracle_gen.$comment: wire.md sec 3.1 -- a trust-plane growth event (conductor-only, D-gold R-forever). The trust seat owns the kind registry (kind-addition is MINOR); bodies vary per kind (e.g. oracle.md 13.1's operator_audit carries case_ref/operator_label/second_authority/second_label/agree/class/ts) -- hence additionalProperties true. Unknown kinds are preserved, never dropped (oracle.md reader liberality)

kind.$comment: the one kind registry is oracle.md-owned (canon #13; wire.md 3.1 delegates); mirrored here from oracle.md's registry table -- kind-addition is an oracle.md MINOR

oracle_gap.$comment: wire.md sec 3.1 -- receipt-contradicting evidence; DATA-class hint to the probe scheduler; NEVER an admission path; postable by any cell (identity-firewall B.9 R14: never privileged)

compact.$comment: wire.md sec 3.1/9 -- a retention event (conductor-only, D-gold R-forever); one record may carry several contiguous runs; anchor-before-effect

archive_ref.$comment: kind=archive only: artifact pointer to the archived JSONL
